caveat: PROVISIONAL own fit: only one training transmission set (EXFOR 12972003, 130-1000 eV), so set admission could not be tested. One p-wave level at 515.8 eV (Gn 2.9 meV) was added to fit an excess; it may be a sample impurity (impurities not stated). Held-out transmission (EXFOR 41088002) chi2/pt 1.67 vs ENDF/B-VIII.1 1.77. Thermal free-atom elastic 24.78 b vs 26.2 +- 2.1 b measured. The Explorer's smooth 1 keV capture value (0.686 b, engine average) is about 37 times this fit's 800-1200 eV average (0.0185 b; join.ratio 0.027): the engine value, not this file, is the outlier. STRUCTRRR final report (2026-10-27): PASS-provisional; the advisory OpenMC gate v3 fails on an MT103 bookkeeping check at 899.8 keV (carrier, outside this fit; the same check fails on ENDF/B-VIII.1). In the hybrid library lib_res_v0 as PROVISIONAL.
